# ALABAAD Engineering Consultants

> ALABAAD is an architecture and engineering consultancy established in Ras Al Khaimah, United Arab Emirates, in 2005.

## Core positioning
- Tailored, context-driven architectural design.
- AOR and approval-related consultancy.
- Multidisciplinary coordination and BIM-enabled project clarity.
- Technology supports professional engineering judgement; it does not replace it.
